name: occupancy

test_list.description: Registers can be identified as the occupancy limiter.
Shared memory can be identified as the occupancy limiter.
Capabilities absent from the supplied versioned table are rejected.
Every row requires an HTTPS provenance URL and retrieval date.
Zero or over-limit block dimensions are rejected.
Table version, duplicate rows, and impossible resource limits are validated.

inputs.name: capability
inputs.description: GPU compute capability key present in the bundled curated NVIDIA table.

inputs.name: launch
inputs.description: Block dimensions and per-thread/per-block resource use.

output_description: Estimated resident blocks/warps and limiting resource; estimate excludes compiler allocation granularity.
